Metrics are then reset, so p4b-events.json contains no retained entry-generation start and matching completed settle from which an independent reviewer can verify the setup. Persist the entry start/settle correlation and reset boundary in P-4b evidence so the condition is independently auditable; fail loudly if Radix produces a no-op.

blocking_findings.finding: The held-getPage canvas-replacement regression does not prove zero metric events for the stale canvas.
